name: venture_ace--chatgpt-search-visibility
title: venture_ace/chatgpt-search-visibility
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/chatgpt-search-visibility" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Ask ChatGPT's web search your customers' questions through the official OpenAI API (your own key) and see if your brand or domain is mentioned or cited. US$5 per 1,000 prompts answered, pay per event.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key (yours)
openaiApiKey.description: Your own OpenAI API key. It is sent only to api.openai.com, is never written to the results or the log, and OpenAI bills you directly for the searches and tokens (web search is billed per call by OpenAI). Without a key the run stops and makes no call. Without a key the run ends with one input_error row and makes no call.

prompts.title: Prompts (questions to ask)
prompts.description:
**REQUIRED** One question per line, as a customer would type it, for example 'best CRM for a small plumbing business'. Duplicates are dropped. Each prompt is one OpenAI web-search call.
Example values: ["best project management tool for small teams"]
prefill: best project management tool for small teams

items.title: Prompts (questions to ask)
items.description: **REQUIRED** One question per line, as a customer would type it, for example 'best CRM for a small plumbing business'. Duplicates are dropped. Each prompt is one OpenAI web-search call.

examples: best project management tool for small teams

brands.title: Brands or domains to look for
brands.description:
**REQUIRED** Brand names ('Acme') and/or domains ('acme.com'). A name counts as mentioned when it appears as a whole word in the answer text (case-insensitive). A domain counts as mentioned when its name part (acme for acme.com) or the full domain appears as a whole word in the text, and as cited when a cited URL is on that domain or a subdomain. Put competitors here too to compare.
Example values: ["asana.com"]

items.title: Brands or domains to look for
items.description: **REQUIRED** Brand names ('Acme') and/or domains ('acme.com'). A name counts as mentioned when it appears as a whole word in the answer text (case-insensitive). A domain counts as mentioned when its name part (acme for acme.com) or the full domain appears as a whole word in the text, and as cited when a cited URL is on that domain or a subdomain. Put competitors here too to compare.

maxPrompts.title: Max prompts per run
maxPrompts.description:
Hard cap on prompts sent in this run; extra prompts are ignored with a log line.
Example values: 50

model.title: OpenAI model
model.description:
Any model your key can use with the Responses API web search tool. Cheaper models cost you less per prompt at OpenAI.
Example values: "gpt-4.1-mini"

country.title: Search country (optional)
country.description: Two-letter country code (for example AU, US, GB) passed as the approximate search location. Leave empty for no location.

searchContextSize.title: Search context size
searchContextSize.description:
How much web content the search tool feeds the model. Higher costs you more at OpenAI.
Example values: "medium"

name: venture_ace--ats-jobs-feed
title: venture_ace/ats-jobs-feed
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/ats-jobs-feed" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: One normalised job postings feed across Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby from company careers URLs, with salary, remote and new-jobs-only filters.

companies.title: Company careers URLs or board tokens
companies.description:
**REQUIRED** Careers pages such as https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb, https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion or a Workday career site such as https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite. The ATS is detected from the URL. A bare token (airbnb) is tried on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby unless you set the ATS below; Workday always needs the full myworkdayjobs.com URL.
Example values: ["https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb","https://jobs.lever.co/palantir","https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion","https://workday.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/Workday"]

items.title: Company careers URLs or board tokens
items.description: **REQUIRED** Careers pages such as https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb, https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.lever.co/palantir, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion or a Workday career site such as https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite. The ATS is detected from the URL. A bare token (airbnb) is tried on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby unless you set the ATS below; Workday always needs the full myworkdayjobs.com URL.

ats.title: ATS for bare tokens
ats.description:
Only used for entries that are not URLs. Auto tries Greenhouse, then Lever, then Ashby.
Example values: "auto"

keywords.title: Keywords (any match)
keywords.description: Keep a job if its title, department or description contains any of these (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all jobs.

items.title: Keywords (any match)
items.description: Keep a job if its title, department or description contains any of these (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop a job if its title, department or description contains any of these.

items.title: Exclude keywords
items.description: Drop a job if its title, department or description contains any of these.

locations.title: Locations (any match)
locations.description: Keep a job if its location text contains any of these, e.g. Sydney, Germany, London.

items.title: Locations (any match)
items.description: Keep a job if its location text contains any of these, e.g. Sydney, Germany, London.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs the ATS marks remote (or whose location says Remote).

postedSince.title: Posted since
postedSince.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a relative window in days (see the README). Jobs without a posted date are dropped when this is set.

onlyNew.title: Only new jobs since the last run
onlyNew.description: Output only jobs not seen in an earlier onlyNew run for the same boards (seen IDs are kept in a key-value store named ats-jobs-feed-seen). Use it on a schedule for a daily delta.

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description:
Stop after this many jobs in total. Keep it small for tests: you pay per job returned.
Example values: 500

stripEmails.title: Remove email addresses from descriptions
stripEmails.description:
Replaces email addresses inside job text with [email removed]. Recommended.
Example values: true

name: venture_ace--audio-transcription
title: venture_ace/audio-transcription
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/audio-transcription" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Audio transcription with Whisper for audio and video files from direct URLs (faster-whisper): text, timed segments, SRT and VTT. One result row per file with its own status; one bad file gets a failed row and the rest still run.

files.title: Audio or video file URLs
files.description:
**REQUIRED** Direct links to audio or video files (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, mp4, webm and anything ffmpeg reads), one per line. Web-page links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and similar) are refused with a per-file error. Localhost and private addresses are refused. Max 500 MB per file.
Example values: ["https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c8/Example.ogg"]

items.title: Audio or video file URLs
items.description: **REQUIRED** Direct links to audio or video files (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, mp4, webm and anything ffmpeg reads), one per line. Web-page links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and similar) are refused with a per-file error. Localhost and private addresses are refused. Max 500 MB per file.

model.title: Whisper model
model.description:
base uses less compute; small is more accurate but slower, so it costs more usage.
Example values: "base"

language.title: Language
language.description:
ISO code such as en, de, es, or auto to detect it from the audio.
Example values: "auto"

outputFormats.title: Output formats
outputFormats.description:
Plain text is always returned. Add timed segments, SRT or VTT subtitles as needed.
Example values: ["segments"]

maxAudioMinutes.title: Max audio minutes per run
maxAudioMinutes.description:
Safety cap on the total audio transcribed in this run. A file that would go past it is returned with status too_long and is not transcribed. Whisper runs on CPU, so long audio takes a while (small: longer); the run stops at the Actor timeout.
Example values: 60

name: venture_ace--bulk-ocr
title: venture_ace/bulk-ocr
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/bulk-ocr" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: OCR for lists of image and PDF URLs with Tesseract. One result row per page with its own status (ok, no_text, unreadable, too_big, fetch_failed), confidence and optional lines; one bad file does not fail the run.

files.title: Image or PDF URLs (or key-value store keys)
files.description:
**REQUIRED** Direct links to images (png, jpg, tiff, bmp, webp, gif) or PDFs, one per line, max 100 MB each. A line that is not a URL is read as a key in this run's default key-value store. Localhost and private addresses are refused, redirects included. Web-page links are refused with a per-file status.
Example values: ["https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdoc/main/images/eurotext.png"]

items.title: Image or PDF URLs (or key-value store keys)
items.description: **REQUIRED** Direct links to images (png, jpg, tiff, bmp, webp, gif) or PDFs, one per line, max 100 MB each. A line that is not a URL is read as a key in this run's default key-value store. Localhost and private addresses are refused, redirects included. Web-page links are refused with a per-file status.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description:
Tesseract languages to read with (several are combined). Installed: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch.
Example values: ["eng"]

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence (0 to 1)
minConfidence.description:
A page whose mean word confidence is below this is returned with status unreadable instead of ok.
Example values: 0.5

maxPages.title: Max pages per run
maxPages.description:
Hard cap on pages read in this run (images count as one page). Pages past the cap get a too_big row and are not read.
Example values: 200

pdfDpi.title: PDF render resolution (dpi)
pdfDpi.description:
Pages of a PDF are rendered at this resolution before reading. Higher reads small print better and runs slower.
Example values: 200

outputFormats.title: Output formats
outputFormats.description:
Plain text is the default. Add lines (text, confidence and box per line) or markdown (text split into paragraphs).
Example values: ["text"]

name: venture_ace--website-screenshot
title: venture_ace/website-screenshot
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/website-screenshot" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Screenshots (PNG or JPEG) and PDFs of any list of URLs with headless Chromium: full page with lazy-load scrolling, desktop/tablet/mobile, wait for a selector, cookie banners hidden. One result row per URL.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description:
**REQUIRED** Pages to capture, one per line. https:// is added if missing. Only public http(s) pages; localhost and private addresses are refused.
Example values: ["https://example.com","https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screenshot"]

items.title: URLs
items.description: **REQUIRED** Pages to capture, one per line. https:// is added if missing. Only public http(s) pages; localhost and private addresses are refused.

format.title: Image format
format.description:
PNG is lossless; JPEG is much smaller for long pages. Choose none to get only PDFs.
Example values: "png"

pdf.title: Also save a PDF
pdf.description: Print each page to PDF (A4 by default) in addition to the image.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description:
Capture the whole scrollable page, not just the first screen. The page is scrolled first so lazy-loaded images appear. Capped at 16,000 px tall.
Example values: true

device.title: Device
device.description:
Viewport and user agent preset. Desktop 1440x900, tablet 820x1180, mobile 390x844.
Example values: "desktop"

viewportWidth.title: Custom viewport width (px)
viewportWidth.description: Overrides the device width. Leave empty to use the preset.

viewportHeight.title: Custom viewport height (px)
viewportHeight.description: Overrides the device height. Leave empty to use the preset.

deviceScaleFactor.title: Pixel ratio
deviceScaleFactor.description:
1 is standard; 2 gives retina-sharp images at four times the pixels (larger files).
Example values: 1

jpegQuality.title: JPEG quality
jpegQuality.description:
1 to 100, used when the format is JPEG.
Example values: 80

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description:
When navigation counts as done. networkidle waits for quiet network and is best for most sites; domcontentloaded is fastest.
Example values: "load"

waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector
waitForSelector.description: CSS selector that must be visible before the capture, for example #app .loaded. If it never appears the row is marked failed (see failOnSelectorTimeout).

failOnSelectorTimeout.title: Fail if the selector never appears
failOnSelectorTimeout.description: Off: capture anyway and note the timeout in the row. On: mark the URL failed.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Fixed wait after the page has loaded, for animations and late widgets.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners and popups
hideCookieBanners.description:
Clicks common 'accept' buttons and hides known consent banners (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi, Quantcast, Usercentrics and generic patterns).
Example values: true

hideSelectors.title: Extra CSS selectors to hide
hideSelectors.description: Anything else to remove from the capture, for example .newsletter-popup or #chat-widget.

items.title: Extra CSS selectors to hide
items.description: Anything else to remove from the capture, for example .newsletter-popup or #chat-widget.

captureErrorPages.title: Capture HTTP error pages
captureErrorPages.description: Off (default): a 4xx/5xx response marks the URL failed, with the status code, and is not charged. On: screenshot the error page anyway.

darkMode.title: Dark colour scheme
darkMode.description: Ask pages for their dark theme (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

pdfFormat.title: PDF paper size
pdfFormat.description:
Paper size for the PDF.
Example values: "A4"

maxUrls.title: Max URLs
maxUrls.description:
Safety cap: only the first N unique URLs are captured.
Example values: 50

concurrency.title: Parallel pages
concurrency.description:
Pages captured at once. Each page uses memory; raise the memory before raising this.
Example values: 3

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per URL (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description:
How long to wait for one page to load before marking it failed.
Example values: 45

name: venture_ace--video-frame-extractor
title: venture_ace/video-frame-extractor
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/video-frame-extractor" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Extract frames from video files at direct URLs with ffmpeg: every N seconds, every Nth frame, at scene changes or at exact timestamps. Frames go to the key-value store as JPG or PNG with a dataset row each (timestamp, url, size). A bad URL gets an error row, never a failed run.

videoUrls.title: Video file URLs
videoUrls.description:
**REQUIRED** Direct links to video files (mp4, webm, mov, mkv and anything ffmpeg reads), one per line, up to 20 per run. Page links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and similar) are refused with a per-video error. Localhost and private addresses are refused. Max 500 MB per file.
Example values: ["https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4"]

items.title: Video file URLs
items.description: **REQUIRED** Direct links to video files (mp4, webm, mov, mkv and anything ffmpeg reads), one per line, up to 20 per run. Page links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and similar) are refused with a per-video error. Localhost and private addresses are refused. Max 500 MB per file.

mode.title: Extraction mode
mode.description:
interval: one frame every N seconds. everyNth: every Nth video frame. sceneChange: the first frame plus a frame at each cut. timestamps: exact times you list.
Example values: "interval"

intervalSeconds.title: Seconds between frames (interval mode)
intervalSeconds.description:
One frame every this many seconds, starting at 0.
Example values: 5

everyNthFrame.title: Frame step (everyNth mode)
everyNthFrame.description:
Keep every Nth decoded frame, starting with the first.
Example values: 30

sceneThreshold.title: Scene change threshold (sceneChange mode)
sceneThreshold.description:
0.05 to 0.95. Lower finds more cuts (0.3 is a good start for most video).
Example values: 0.3

timestamps.title: Timestamps (timestamps mode)
timestamps.description: Seconds (12.5) or clock time (1:30, 00:01:30.5), one per line. A time past the end of the video is skipped with a note.

items.title: Timestamps (timestamps mode)
items.description: Seconds (12.5) or clock time (1:30, 00:01:30.5), one per line. A time past the end of the video is skipped with a note.

imageFormat.title: Image format
imageFormat.description:
jpg is smaller; png is lossless and much larger.
Example values: "jpg"

maxWidth.title: Max frame width (pixels)
maxWidth.description:
Frames wider than this are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio. Frames are never scaled up.
Example values: 1280

maxFramesPerVideo.title: Max frames per video
maxFramesPerVideo.description:
Safety cap per video. Extraction stops there and the last row notes it.
Example values: 50

maxFramesTotal.title: Max frames per run
maxFramesTotal.description:
Safety cap on all frames in this run (and so on what the run can charge). Videos after it are returned with status skipped.
Example values: 100

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

name: venture_ace--broken-link-checker
title: venture_ace/broken-link-checker
description:
This tool calls the Actor "venture_ace/broken-link-checker" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Check the links on a page or a whole small site and get one row per link: ok, redirect, broken, or blocked. Confirms every failure with a GET after HEAD, and reports bot-protected links (403, 429, challenges) as blocked, never as broken. Honours robots.txt.

startUrls.title: Page or link URLs
startUrls.description:
**REQUIRED** Up to 10 URLs, one per line. In pageLinks and crawlSite mode these are pages whose links are checked; in urlList mode each one is itself checked. Localhost and private addresses are refused.
Example values: ["https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains"]

items.title: Page or link URLs
items.description: **REQUIRED** Up to 10 URLs, one per line. In pageLinks and crawlSite mode these are pages whose links are checked; in urlList mode each one is itself checked. Localhost and private addresses are refused.

mode.title: What to check
mode.description:
pageLinks: the links on each page you list. crawlSite: also read same-site pages, up to maxPages. urlList: just check the URLs you list.
Example values: "pageLinks"

maxPages.title: Max pages to read (crawlSite)
maxPages.description:
Pages read in crawlSite mode, including the start pages.
Example values: 10

maxLinks.title: Max links to check
maxLinks.description:
Safety cap on unique links checked in this run (and so on what it can charge). Extra links are reported in the run summary, not checked.
Example values: 200

checkExternal.title: Check links to other sites
checkExternal.description:
Off: only links on the same site as the page are checked.
Example values: true

includeImages.title: Also check images
includeImages.description: Adds img src links to the check.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description:
A link with no answer after two tries is reported as timeout, not broken.
Example values: 15
